findings: New wave-2 template distilled from a field workflow pattern; the field implementation depended on live mailbox, CRM and document-store connections and customer data that cannot ship in a public library.
The field pattern spread the workflow across several cooperating agents with shared mutable state.
Outreach and write-back steps in the field pattern acted on external systems once a person approved them.
fixes: Re-authored the workflow as one single-file agent over a fixed, fully fictional synthetic snapshot with no customer names, identifiers, tenants or record values.
Collapsed the stages into 6 deterministic, stateless operations with an operation enum and enum or resolver inputs only, so every output is reproducible.
Every outreach, write-back and submission step returns a reviewable draft marked not sent, and the response states the human approval boundary.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
